build.beforeBuildCommand: pnpm run build:sidecar && pnpm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: Your courses, ready for the AI app you already use
bundle.longDescription: Weekmark keeps your course materials, weekly structure and deadlines on your computer and serves them over MCP to the AI app you already use (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex). It never solves or submits assignments.
